channels._comment: Email vs Facebook volume per store, in three consecutive 28-day buckets, from Commslayer reports_inboxes. 'tickets' = conversations opened in that inbox; 'received' = inbound customer messages; 'sent' = messages the team (or AI) sent back; 'res' = average resolution seconds. Facebook page inboxes were only connected part-way through the window, so earlier buckets are legitimately zero.
